dynamicBoundary: sum of every ApplyChanges operation in a same-tick event group plus every mandatory post-event Plan query for all N registered agents after the complete group

rawObservationLayers.unit: one named algorithm lane within one superblock
one raw metric value at one frozen measurement point
one complete same-tick event group within one lane
one change operation, event, or post-event query
one state measurement point and one named state component

primaryDomains.name: complete dynamic handling latency
primaryDomains.domainRule: conjunctive intersection-union: for each comparator the domain-level p-value is max(one-sided p for geometric mean, one-sided p for P95), and both simultaneous intervals must be entirely below 1; the domain must satisfy this against all five named comparators
primaryDomains.rawDeliverability: all 24 eventGroupElapsedMilliseconds observations per eligible lane must remain available; summaries alone are insufficient

primaryDomains.name: common grid accessor work
primaryDomains.instrument: shared read-only counting proxy outside all six algorithms
primaryDomains.primaryValue: unweighted total number of public grid accessor calls
primaryDomains.domainRule: adjusted interval entirely below 1 against all five named comparators
primaryDomains.rawDeliverability: total and each component count must be delivered for every event group; a total-only or percentage-only file fails the gate

primaryDomains.name: managed allocation during complete dynamic handling

instrumentQualification.preferred: GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread after monotonic non-zero sensitivity validation
instrumentQualification.precollectionFallback: validated Unity ProfilerRecorder GC allocation counter frozen before formal collection

primaryDomains.estimand: adjusted ratio-like contrast on log1p scale with raw-byte summaries
primaryDomains.domainRule: adjusted interval entirely favorable against all five named comparators
primaryDomains.rawDeliverability: every event-group byte count, counter identity, counter start/end values, and validity state must be retained

primaryDomains.name: audited logical persistent planner state capacity
measurementPoints: after each of 24 completed dynamic event groups
primaryDomains.meaning: logical owned state capacity under a frozen audited formula; not process RSS and not total managed heap
primaryDomains.estimand: adjusted ratio-like contrast on log1p scale with raw-byte summaries
primaryDomains.domainRule: adjusted interval entirely favorable against all five named comparators
primaryDomains.rawDeliverability: each named component at every measurement point must be delivered; maximum-only storage fails the gate

primaryDomains.name: dynamic latency scaling with agent count
primaryDomains.rawOutcome: D1 event-group observations and their block geometric mean
primaryDomains.estimand: algorithm-by-log2(N) slope difference IDFF minus comparator
primaryDomains.domainRule: adjusted slope-difference interval entirely below 0 against all five named comparators
primaryDomains.rawDeliverability: all D1 constituent values and the exact N attached to every record are required; slope estimates are derived, not raw

primaryDomains.name: dynamic latency scaling with changed-cell footprint
primaryDomains.rawOutcome: D1 event-group observations and their block geometric mean
primaryDomains.estimand: algorithm-by-log2(F) slope difference IDFF minus comparator
primaryDomains.domainRule: adjusted slope-difference interval entirely below 0 against all five named comparators
primaryDomains.note: C-FF may legitimately have a flatter footprint slope because it always rebuilds the full field; absolute latency remains a separate domain
primaryDomains.rawDeliverability: all D1 constituent values, exact F, input operation identities, and atomic partition schedule are required

primaryDomains.name: dynamic latency scaling with grid cell count
primaryDomains.rawOutcome: D1 event-group observations and their block geometric mean
primaryDomains.estimand: algorithm-by-log2(grid cell count) slope difference IDFF minus comparator
primaryDomains.domainRule: adjusted slope-difference interval entirely below 0 against all five named comparators
primaryDomains.rawDeliverability: all D1 constituent values and exact grid dimensions attached to every record are required

secondaryTradeoffEndpoints.sentinelSubsetStatus: exact subset must be fixed by a separately authorized precollection amendment if retained

classification.IDFF_ADVANTAGE: all required Holm-adjusted simultaneous intervals for the domain are favorable versus all five comparators
classification.UNRESOLVED: the domain is valid but the required intervals do not resolve one direction
classification.COMPARATOR_ADVANTAGE: a symmetric adjusted interval is entirely favorable to one or more named comparators
classification.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: the frozen instrument or endpoint contract failed; the domain remains in the denominator and blocks a majority-support claim

multiplicity.family: 7 endpoint domains times IDFF versus 5 named comparators
multiplicity.D1ContrastConstruction: five domain-level intersection-union contrasts, not ten separate opportunities
multiplicity.method: Holm strong family-wise error control at alpha 0.05
multiplicity.intervals: two-sided simultaneous confidence intervals consistent with the adjusted tests
multiplicity.allFifteenPairMatrices: all 15 unordered pairs in the 6-by-6 matrix are reported as a separately labelled exploratory Holm family per endpoint domain
